warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLS63 AMG Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your GLS63 AMG has the M157 (X166 generation, 2012–2019): this 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 is known for valve seal and coolant system wear over time — an established pattern across AMG V8s of this era. We replace valve seals, timing chain components, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild.

If your GLS63 AMG has the M177 (X167 generation, 2019–present): this 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 shares a similar valve seal and coolant system wear pattern with its predecessor. We replace valve seals, timing chain components, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M177 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, cross-referenced throughout Mercedes G-BRF and confirmed in VRF-mercedes-gls.md. Both engine codes included in the claim per VRF coverage
